rows.corpus_definition: Happening right now at this current time.
rows.example_en: The office is presently closed for the holiday.

rows.corpus_definition: To believe something is true without having total proof.
rows.example_en: I presume you are hungry after the long walk.

rows.corpus_definition: to say something publicly or officially to everyone
rows.example_en: The king did proclaim peace across land.

rows.corpus_definition: The rate at which work is finished.
rows.example_en: Focusing well can improve your productivity.

rows.corpus_definition: Showing great knowledge or very deep feelings.
rows.example_en: The book had a profound impact on me.

rows.corpus_definition: An angry disagreement between people who know each other.
rows.example_en: They had a minor quarrel about money.

rows.corpus_definition: A state of feeling extremely angry.
rows.example_en: His face turned red with sudden rage.

rows.corpus_definition: To find a way to make two different ideas work together.
rows.example_en: They must reconcile their differences to succeed.

rows.corpus_definition: A tall grass that grows in wet ground.
rows.example_en: The wind whistled through the green reed.

rows.corpus_definition: To stop yourself from doing something.
rows.example_en: Please refrain from talking in the library.
